reason: I already pay a tutor for first-grade prep, and 25 thousand a month is nothing next to that. If 10 minutes of letters in Russian replaces the cartoons the grandparents put on anyway, and the weekly report shows me real progress, I'll pay for the monthly plan after the trial.
objection: I don't want my child glued to the phone. The grandparents won't stick to 10 minutes, and if after two weeks the report shows nothing the tutor isn't already teaching, it's just more screen time.
would_change_my_mind: If the trial report shows nothing new beyond what the tutor covers, or the child keeps asking for more phone time, I cancel and take the refund.
